questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following statements are correct regarding Influence line diagram?
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements are correct regarding Influence line diagram?

options.html: The ILD for reaction, SF or BM is linear for determinate structures and combination of straight line and curve for indeterminate structures
options.text: The ILD for reaction, SF or BM is linear for determinate structures and combination of straight line and curve for indeterminate structures

options.html: For a UDL shorter than span, the maximum bending moment at any section occurs when the section divides load in same ratio as it divides the span.
options.text: For a UDL shorter than span, the maximum bending moment at any section occurs when the section divides load in same ratio as it divides the span.

options.html: For simply supported beam, ILD for BM at any section is triangular
options.text: For simply supported beam, ILD for BM at any section is triangular

options.html: For simply supported beam, ILD for SF at any section is rectangular
options.text: For simply supported beam, ILD for SF at any section is rectangular

questions.explanationHtml:
(a, b, c)
The ILD for reaction, SF or BM is linear for determinate structure and combination of straight
line and curve for indeterminate structures.
For a UDL shorter than span, the maximum bending moment at any section will be when the
section divides load in same ratio as it divides the span.
For simply supported beam, ILD for BM at any section is triangular and ILD for SF is triangular.
